scope: Separate 1 m/s operating point, three full-route commissioning attempts. No comparison to frozen 0.16 m/s pilot.
preparation_amendment: V1 time-scaled spatial preview caused route deviation and a clearance-guard stop. V2 restores 0.20 m tracker lookahead, 0.65 m local-goal distance and 1.50 m forward search; increases target-distance speed gain to 5/s so 1 m/s is reachable; reduces linear speed to obey 0.4 rad/s angular bound rather than clipping angular command alone. Other planner, estimator, camera, guard and success settings unchanged. Separate commissioning configuration, no pooling with v1 or 0.16 m/s pilot.
